answer: Require each agent to post a stake before joining a work bridge, with slashing when verifiers prove duplicated or false output. Like a wharf charging every vessel a berth bond, one operator running many fake identities must pay the bond many times, while an honest agent pays once and recovers it from fees. Add a reputation signal: only identities with a history of attested work gain voting or routing weight, so fresh Sybils start near zero and cannot outvote established agents without buying a costly history. Creating an identity stays cheap; creating trusted influence becomes unprofitable.
